# Niklas Braun

> Full-stack developer focused on Shopware 6 and Flutter. I build plugins, integrations, and apps, currently at Sharpness Solutions. Based in Oldenburg, Germany.

German version: https://nibraun.de/de/

## Projects

- [CampAlong](https://campalong.de): Local-first Flutter app for turning GPX routes into trip-ready multi-day journeys — with stages, overnight stops, water, and supplies along the route. Stack: Flutter · GPX · Local-first.
- [Drift](https://github.com/WariKoda/drift): TUI for browsing, diffing, and syncing files with remote hosts over SFTP/SSH and FTP, including side-by-side diffs and per-file sync directions. Stack: Go · TUI · SFTP / SSH · FTP.
- [Admin Toolbar](https://github.com/WariKoda/WakoPluginAdminToolbar): Shopware 6 plugin that shows an admin toolbar in the storefront — similar to WordPress. Stack: Shopware 6 · PHP · Twig · JavaScript.
- [Sippy](https://github.com/nibra180/sippy): SIP softphone for the Linux desktop built with Rust and GPUI, designed for Omarchy on Hyprland. Controls baresip over D-Bus and includes contacts, call history, and audio settings. Stack: Rust · GPUI · baresip · D-Bus.

## Stack

- E-commerce: Shopware 6, PHP, Symfony, Twig, Vue.js, TypeScript, TYPO3
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Drift (SQLite), Supabase, Kotlin
- Tools: Go, Rust, Node.js
- Agents: Pi, Claude Code, Codex, Herdr
- Workflow: Docker Compose, DDEV, Neovim, Zed, PhpStorm, Git

## Experience

- 2025 to now: Full-stack developer, Sharpness Solutions
- 2021 to 2025: Frontend developer & web designer, WL Online
- 2018 to 2021: Apprenticeship in digital/print media design, WL Online
